keyVerseDR: "Wherefore putting away lying, speak ye the truth every man with his neighbour." (Eph 4:25)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Honesty
level1.story: Honesty means telling the truth and acting the same way when no one is watching. Jesus is the Truth!
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice honesty all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When was telling the truth hard this week?
How does honesty help our family trust each other?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are the Truth. Help me speak truthfully and keep my promises. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Tell the truth about something you did
TUE: Keep a promise you made
WED: Return something that isn't yours
THU: Admit a mistake and say sorry
FRI: Play a game fairly without cheating
SAT: Tell God the truth in your prayers

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Honesty
level2.story: Honesty means telling the truth and living with integrity: being the same person on the inside and the outside. Honest people keep promises, admit mistakes, and do not cheat or take what is not theirs. Saint Paul tells us to put away lying and speak the truth. Jesus said, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life." When we are honest, we follow Him.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice honesty all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When was telling the truth hard this week?
How did God help us grow in honesty?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Jesus, You are the Truth. Help me speak truthfully and keep my promises. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Own up to a mistake before someone asks
TUE: Be honest even when it costs you
WED: Give back extra change or credit
THU: Keep your word on a chore you promised
FRI: Do your work honestly, without copying
SAT: Prepare for an honest Confession
